text:
I recently bought a used Baratza Encore, and it’s been a bit of a mixed bag. Since I mostly brew pour-overs and espresso, I’m really happy with the fine settings; the grind consistency there is excellent for the price. However, when I try to coarsen it up for French press, the results are incredibly uneven, leaving way too many boulders and fines. 

Another downside is the motor—it is shockingly noisy, enough to wake up my roommate in the morning. On the bright side, the removable grounds cup is a lifesaver. It slides out smoothly and makes cleaning up static-cling chaff much easier.
task: Write a fictional personal review of a used coffee grinder: uneven coarse settings, good fine settings, a noisy motor, and a removable cup that makes cleaning easier.
